name: Battle

components.pose: She charges forward in a wide lunge with her flame sword swept back in one hand and the other palm thrust forward, hair and cape streaming, a fierce, exhilarated gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A wave of living flame rolls out from her palm and the blade is wreathed in fire, embers and sparks streaming past her, heat haze warping the air behind her.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
